title: Technology, controls, and ownership frustrations
summary: Feedback in this topic mixes enthusiastic reactions to the car and its technology with complaints about breakdowns, insurance or after-sales handling, and some ambiguous remarks about dashboard usability.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car overall, saying it stands out and highlighting the technology as impressive.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on serious reliability trouble and poor dealer or insurance handling that left owners disappointed.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention after-sales problems and unclear reactions to the car feeling talkative, in control, or to the electronic dash, but the sentiment is not consistently clear from the fragments alone.

limitations: The topic clusters several subjects together, including overall praise, technology and dashboard usability, breakdowns, and dealer or insurance issues, so it is not a single coherent theme.
Some example fragments appear semantically ambiguous or potentially misassigned relative to their labeled sentiment, so conclusions should stay close to the quoted text.
Examples are short fragment-level excerpts, which limits confidence about the full context of each review.
